Person_Name: Sirisena Cooray
Position_at_Time: Former UNP General Secretary and Cabinet Minister
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / Security Services
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Detained under Emergency Regulations for alleged anti-government activities
Political_Context: High tension following the October 2000 general elections and minority government formation.

Person_Name: General Anuruddha Ratwatte, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Attorney General's Department, Teldeniya Magistrate Court
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest of General Anuruddha Ratwatte over Udathalawinna Election Massacre
Political_Context: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) arrested General Anuruddha Ratwatte, former Cabinet Minister of Power & Energy and Deputy Minister of Defence, on an order issued by Attorney General K.C. Kamalasabeyson. He was charged with conspiracy and aiding and abetting the election-day murder of 10 Muslim youths at Udathalawinna during the December 2001 election.

Person_Name: S.B. Dissanayake
Position_at_Time: UNP National Organizer and Senior Member of Parliament
Arresting_Authority: Supreme Court of Sri Lanka / Prison Authorities
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Sentenced to 2 years rigorous imprisonment for Contempt of Court
Political_Context: Major opposition figure jailed during tense parliamentary period.
Source_1_Name: Supreme Court of Sri Lanka Judgments

Person_Name: President Mahinda Rajapaksa / S.B. Dissanayake / Supreme Court of Sri Lanka
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Presidential Pardon and Release of Opposition Politician S.B. Dissanayake
Political_Context: President Mahinda Rajapaksa granted a full presidential pardon under Article 34 of the Constitution to former UNP Cabinet Minister S.B. Dissanayake, releasing him from prison after serving 14 months of a two-year sentence for contempt of court. The move restored Dissanayake's political rights and restored his ability to contest future parliamentary elections. This gesture was seen as an effort to ease inter-party political friction early in Rajapaksa's presidential term.

Person_Name: Sripathi Sooriyaarachchi / CID / Ministry of Public Security
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest of Dissident MP and Former Minister Sripathi Sooriyaarachchi
Political_Context: Former Cabinet Minister Sripathi Sooriyaarachchi was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) on charges of misusing government vehicles following his dismissal from cabinet. Sooriyaarachchi had recently publicly accused senior government officials of corruption and secret agreements with the LTTE. Opposition parties condemned the arrest as political retaliation against dissidents.

Person_Name: J.S. Tissainayagam / Terrorist Investigation Division (TID) / European Union
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest of Senior Journalist J.S. Tissainayagam Under Prevention of Terrorism Act
Political_Context: Prominent Tamil journalist and editor J.S. Tissainayagam was arrested by the Terrorist Investigation Division (TID) under Emergency Regulations and the Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA). He was detained over editorials criticizing military operations in the North. His detention attracted international human rights scrutiny and warnings from the European Union regarding trade preference renewals.
Source_1_Name: Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) / Amnesty International

Person_Name: Lalith Kotelawala / CID / Supreme Court of Sri Lanka / Ceylinco Group
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest of Ceylinco Chairman Lalith Kotelawala Over Golden Key Collapse
Political_Context: Tycoon Lalith Kotelawala, Chairman of Ceylinco Consolidated and former presidential advisor, was arrested by the CID in Colombo following the Rs. 26.5 billion financial collapse of Golden Key Credit Card Company. Thousands of depositors lost funds in the unregulated deposit scheme. The high-profile arrest signaled strict judicial and police action against financial fraud in shadow banking.

Person_Name: Kumaran Pathmanathan (KP) / Sri Lanka Intelligence Services / Ministry of Defence
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest and Extradition of LTTE Leader Kumaran Pathmanathan (KP)
Political_Context: Kumaran Pathmanathan (KP), chief international arms procurer and appointed successor to LTTE leader Velupillai Prabhakaran, was arrested by Sri Lankan intelligence officers in Southeast Asia (Malaysia/Thailand) and flown to Colombo. His detainment dismantled the overseas financial network of the LTTE and eliminated remaining insurgent leadership threats.
Source_1_Name: BBC News / Ministry of Defence Sri Lanka

Person_Name: General Sarath Fonseka / Military Police / Ministry of Defence
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest of Main Opposition Candidate General Sarath Fonseka
Political_Context: Military Police forcibly arrested former Army Commander and common opposition candidate General Sarath Fonseka at his Colombo office. Fonseka was detained on military charges of political involvement while in uniform and alleged anti-government conspiracy. The arrest triggered street protests, opposition boycotts, and international diplomatic concern.

Person_Name: Vijitha Herath / JVP / Sri Lanka Police
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrest of JVP MP Vijitha Herath During Protests Against Fonseka Detainment
Political_Context: Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP) Member of Parliament Vijitha Herath and dozens of opposition activists were arrested by police during demonstrations in Colombo demanding the release of General Sarath Fonseka. The police crackdown underscored strict enforcement of public order regulations following the presidential election.

Person_Name: Sarath Fonseka / Military Court Martial / President Mahinda Rajapaksa
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: First Court Martial Convicts General Sarath Fonseka
Political_Context: The first military Court Martial panel convicted General Sarath Fonseka of engaging in political activity while in active military service. President Rajapaksa ratified the verdict, resulting in Fonseka being dishonorably discharged from the army and stripped of all military titles, decorations, and pensions.

Person_Name: Sarath Fonseka / Court Martial Panel / President Mahinda Rajapaksa
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Second Court Martial Sentences Sarath Fonseka to 30 Months Imprisonment
Political_Context: The second military Court Martial found Sarath Fonseka guilty of corruption in military equipment procurement dealings and sentenced him to 30 months of rigorous imprisonment. President Mahinda Rajapaksa ratified the sentence on September 30, 2010, leading to Fonseka's transfer to Welikada Prison.

Person_Name: Speaker Chamal Rajapaksa / Parliament of Sri Lanka / Sarath Fonseka
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Sarath Fonseka Stripped of Parliamentary Seat
Political_Context: Speaker Chamal Rajapaksa announced in Parliament that General Sarath Fonseka was disqualified from serving as a Member of Parliament under Article 66 of the Constitution following the ratification of his 30-month prison sentence. Fonseka was subsequently replaced in Parliament by Democratic National Alliance (DNA) candidate Laxman Nipuna Arachchi.
Source_1_Name: Parliament of Sri Lanka / Daily Mirror

Person_Name: General Sarath Fonseka
Arresting_Authority: Colombo High Court / Prisons Department
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Sentenced to 3 years imprisonment in 'White Flag' statement trial
Political_Context: High-profile sentencing of primary 2010 presidential opponent.

Person_Name: General Sarath Fonseka
Position_at_Time: Former Army Chief and Opposition Leader
Arresting_Authority: Presidential Secretariat / Prisons Department
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Released via unconditional Presidential Pardon signed by President Rajapaksa
Political_Context: Followed heavy domestic and international diplomatic pressure regarding political prisoner status.

Person_Name: Basil Rajapaksa
Arresting_Authority: Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID) / Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Arrested over alleged financial misappropriation of Divineguma department funds
Political_Context: First high-profile arrest of a Rajapaksa family member under the new government's anti-corruption drive.

Person_Name: Namal Rajapaksa; Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID); Krrish Group; Colombo Fort Magistrate Court
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: MP Namal Rajapaksa Arrested by FCID Over Misappropriation of Funds
Political_Context: Member of Parliament Namal Rajapaksa, son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, was arrested by the Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID) over alleged misappropriation of Rs. 70 million related to a real estate agreement with India's Krrish Group. He was remanded by the Fort Magistrate before being released on bail on July 18.

Person_Name: Namal Rajapaksa; Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID); Gowers Corporate Services; HelloCorp
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Namal Rajapaksa Arrested Second Time by FCID Over Money Laundering Charges
Political_Context: MP Namal Rajapaksa was arrested for a second time by the Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID) in connection with money laundering charges involving Rs. 125 million allegedly used to purchase shares of HelloCorp through Gowers Corporate Services. He was remanded until August 22, 2016.

Person_Name: Mahindananda Aluthgamage; Criminal Investigation Department (CID); Colombo Magistrate Court
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Minister Mahindananda Aluthgamage Arrested Over Money Laundering Charges
Political_Context: Former Sports Minister and Joint Opposition MP Mahindananda Aluthgamage was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act over undisclosed sources of income used to acquire a luxury property on Kynsey Road, Colombo 7. He was remanded by the Colombo Additional Magistrate.

Person_Name: Lalith Weeratunga; Anusha Palpita; Colombo High Court; Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC)
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Presidential Secretary Lalith Weeratunga Sentenced to 3 Years Imprisonment
Political_Context: Former Secretary to the President Lalith Weeratunga and former TRC Director General Anusha Palpita were convicted and sentenced to 3 years rigorous imprisonment by the Colombo High Court for misappropriating Rs. 600 million of Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC) funds to distribute Sil Cloth during the 2015 presidential campaign.

Person_Name: Nalaka de Silva; Criminal Investigation Department (CID); Maithripala Sirisena; Gotabaya Rajapaksa
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former TID Chief Nalaka de Silva Arrested Over Alleged Presidential Assassination Plot
Political_Context: Former Deputy Inspector General (DIG) and Director of the Terrorism Investigation Division (TID) Nalaka de Silva was arrested by the CID following days of interrogation over an alleged plot to assassinate President Maithripala Sirisena and former Defence Secretary Gotabaya Rajapaksa. The arrest escalated severe political tensions within the executive branch.

Person_Name: Patali Champika Ranawaka; Colombo Crimes Division (CCD); United National Party (UNP); Attorney General's Department
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Minister Patali Champika Ranawaka Arrested Over 2016 Accident Case
Political_Context: Former Megapolis Minister and UNP MP Patali Champika Ranawaka was arrested by the Colombo Crimes Division (CCD) at his residence on instructions of the Attorney General over a 2016 road accident in Rajagiriya. Opposition members denounced the arrest as political victimisation following the presidential election.

Person_Name: Rajitha Senaratne; Criminal Investigation Department (CID); United National Party (UNP); Colombo Magistrate Court
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Health Minister Rajitha Senaratne Arrested Over 'White Van' Press Conference
Political_Context: Former Health Minister and UNP MP Rajitha Senaratne was arrested by the CID while receiving treatment at a private hospital in Colombo following a court warrant issued over his organization of a controversial 'white van' media conference ahead of the 2019 presidential election. He was granted bail on December 30.

Person_Name: Ranjan Ramanayake; Colombo Crimes Division (CCD); Nugegoda Magistrate Court; United National Party (UNP)
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: UNP MP Ranjan Ramanayake Arrested Over Audio Recordings and Judicial Interference
Political_Context: Opposition MP Ranjan Ramanayake was arrested by the Colombo Crimes Division (CCD) following an arrest warrant issued by the Nugegoda Magistrate over leaked audio recordings allegedly showing interference with judicial officers and law enforcement. This followed an earlier search and arrest on January 4 for an unlicensed firearm.

Person_Name: Rishad Bathiudeen; Criminal Investigation Department (CID); All Ceylon Makkal Congress (ACMC); Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB)
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Minister Rishad Bathiudeen Arrested Over Misuse of State Buses
Political_Context: Former Industry and Commerce Minister and ACMC leader Rishad Bathiudeen was arrested by the CID in Dehiwala. He was charged with misappropriating public funds by misusing 222 SLTB buses to transport internally displaced voters during the November 2019 presidential election.

Person_Name: Rishad Bathiudeen MP, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Sri Lanka Police
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Cabinet Minister Rishad Bathiudeen Arrested Under Prevention of Terrorism Act
Political_Context: Former Minister of Industry and Commerce and Vanni District MP Rishad Bathiudeen was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) on April 24, 2021, under the Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA). He was detained in connection with alleged aiding and abetting of the suicide bombers involved in the 2019 Easter Sunday attacks. His arrest sparked significant political debate regarding selective prosecution of minority political leaders.

Person_Name: Prasanna Ranatunga, Colombo High Court, Attorney General's Department
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Cabinet Minister Prasanna Ranatunga Convicted and Sentenced for Extortion
Political_Context: Sitting Cabinet Minister Prasanna Ranatunga was convicted by the Colombo High Court on June 6, 2022, in a 2015 extortion case involving a land dispute in Meethotamulla. The court sentenced him to two years of rigorous imprisonment suspended for five years, alongside a Rs. 25 million fine and Rs. 1 million in victim compensation.

Person_Name: Dhaniz Ali, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), BIA Airport Police
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Aragalaya Activist Dhaniz Ali Arrested Onboard Flight at BIA
Political_Context: Prominent anti-government protest leader Dhaniz Ali was arrested by CID officers on July 26, 2022, while seated on a Dubai-bound aircraft at Katunayake Airport. He was wanted for forcibly entering the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation studio and disrupting live broadcasts on July 13, 2022. The arrest marked an escalated law enforcement posture against protest figures.

Person_Name: Joseph Stalin, Ceylon Teachers' Union (CTU), Sri Lanka Police
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Ceylon Teachers' Union General Secretary Joseph Stalin Arrested in Post-Aragalaya Crackdown
Political_Context: Prominent trade unionist Joseph Stalin was arrested by police on August 3, 2022, for allegedly violating a court order during a May 2022 protest march. His detention provoked international criticism from UN human rights rapporteurs before he was granted bail on August 9, 2022.

Person_Name: Ali Sabry Raheem MP, Sri Lanka Customs, Parliament of Sri Lanka
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: MP Ali Sabry Raheem Detained at BIA for Smuggling Gold and Smartphones
Political_Context: Puttalam District MP Ali Sabry Raheem was detained by Customs officers at Katunayake Airport on May 23, 2023, carrying 3.39 kg of undeclared gold and 91 smartphones valued at over Rs. 78 million via the VIP lounge. He was fined Rs. 7.5 million and released after confiscation of the goods; Parliament later suspended him for one month in March 2024.

Person_Name: Keheliya Rambukwella, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), National Medicines Regulatory Authority (NMRA)
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Health Minister Keheliya Rambukwella Arrested Over Substandard Immunoglobulin Procurement
Political_Context: Environment Minister (former Health Minister) Keheliya Rambukwella was arrested by the CID on February 2, 2024, following questioning over the procurement of counterfeit intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) vials using forged documents. He was remanded by the Maligakanda Magistrate's Court, highlighting high-level accountability in state drug procurements.

Person_Name: Hirunika Premachandra, Colombo High Court, Attorney General's Department
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former MP Hirunika Premachandra Sentenced to 3 Years Imprisonment in Abduction Case
Political_Context: Former MP Hirunika Premachandra was convicted and sentenced to three years of rigorous imprisonment by the Colombo High Court on June 28, 2024, over 18 charges stemming from the 2015 abduction and assault of a youth in Dematagoda. She was remanded to Welikada Prison before being granted bail pending appeal on July 22, 2024.

Person_Name: Johnston Fernando, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former Minister Johnston Fernando Arrested Over Unregistered Stolen BMW Vehicle
Political_Context: Former Minister Johnston Fernando was arrested by the CID on October 23, 2024, after giving a statement regarding an unregistered luxury BMW discovered at a Colombo hotel. Investigations indicated the vehicle was illegally assembled using parts stolen in the UK in 2021; he was remanded before being granted bail on October 30.

Person_Name: Lohan Ratwatte, Sri Lanka Police, Nugegoda Magistrate's Court
Arresting_Authority: Sri Lanka Police / CID / Military Police
Official_Reason_for_Arrest: Former State Minister Lohan Ratwatte Arrested Over Unregistered Lexus SUV
Political_Context: Former State Minister Lohan Ratwatte was arrested in Kandy by Mirihana Police on October 31, 2024, after an unregistered luxury Lexus SUV with forged license plates was found at his wife's Mirihana residence. He was remanded by Nugegoda Magistrate's Court under the Motor Traffic and Customs Acts.
